response.overview: Aidil wins a five-day vacation prize at a luxury hotel, but gives it to his father, Pak Karim, who is obsessed with his pet chicken. The vacation unexpectedly reunites Pak Karim with his ex-wife, Shida, who happens to be staying at the same hotel. Although they initially try to avoid each other, old memories and lingering feelings begin to rekindle their relationship. Meanwhile, Pak Karim's obsession with bringing the chicken to the hotel causes chaos and misunderstandings about an H5N1 outbreak. A contractor named Jerry also tries hard to buy the chicken because he believes it brings good fortune. Finally, with the help of Aidil and his wife, Pak Karim and Shida's relationship is restored, and they reunite as husband and wife.
